trade_cards.name: Brent/WTI 30-45D supply-shock Call Spread
trade_cards.structure: prefer WTI 30-45D buy 35-40d call / sell 15-20d call; Brent equivalent acceptable; use call butterfly if debit >40% of width
trade_cards.entry: after Sep6 OPEC+ outcome and North American Sunday-evening futures reopen; if policy broadly unchanged, no credible US-Iran de-escalation, and after 45-60m WTI holds 92-94 / Brent holds around 95 or higher without fast reversal, enter half; add only with new shipping/insurance/mining/Kharg/military disruption and WTI >96-98; do not chase if WTI opens above 100 without pullback
trade_cards.invalidation: WTI<87 or Brent<88 plus verified Hormuz normalization/de-escalation; or OPEC+ unexpectedly adds material deliverable supply
trade_cards.iv_skew: live OVX/Brent-WTI option surface unavailable during weekend; reject trade if reopen skew/Vega makes debit >40% of width
trade_cards.catalysts: Sep6 OPEC+; US-Iran/Kharq/Hormuz shipping; Sep10 US EIA holiday-delayed WPSR
trade_cards.worst_case: OPEC+ supply increase + US-Iran de-escalation + shipping normalization produce downside gap and IV crush
trade_cards.abandon_if: reopen gap is already extreme and no favorable risk-defined pricing remains

trade_cards.name: Long IH2609 / Short IM2609
trade_cards.structure: Long 12 IH2609 / Short 7 IM2609 reference basket; multipliers 300 and 200 CNY/pt; notionals about CNY10.497m vs CNY10.455m
trade_cards.entry: Monday 09:30-10:15 only if IH leads IM >=0.35ppt; IH main OI stays positive or all-maturity OI does not reverse; IM main OI does not rebuild >1.5%-2% as aggressive longs; IM basis <=-0.55% to -0.60% and at least ~20bp deeper than IH; MO ATM IV >=28% and RR25 <=-3.5vol without CSI1000 panic >2.5%; do not chase opening relative gap >1ppt; add at >=0.65-0.75ppt lead
trade_cards.invalidation: pair relative PnL -0.65ppt; or IM beats IH >=0.55ppt with material positive IM main OI and MO RR25 >-2.5vol; or policy/liquidity catalyst reignites small-cap beta
trade_cards.max_loss: non-limited; about CNY105k per 1ppt adverse move on matched notional before basis/slippage/roll/margin/gap
trade_cards.greeks: near-linear relative Delta; Gamma/Theta/Vega approximately zero
trade_cards.iv_skew: MO2609 ATM 28.87%, RR25 -3.82vol, 10d put IV 37.09%; futures pair preferred to chasing rich MO puts
trade_cards.catalysts: Monday style follow-through; Sep9 China CPI/PPI; liquidity/style flow
trade_cards.worst_case: small-cap policy/liquidity catalyst triggers overnight relative gap
trade_cards.abandon_if: IH OI reverses, IM aggressive longs rebuild, skew normalizes and IM relative strength returns
